summary_en: AS ONE CORPORATION completed cancellation of 2,600,000 shares on October 30, 2026, representing 3.47% of issued shares before cancellation. Post-cancellation issued shares total 72,412,540.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: AS ONE CORPORATION announced on October 30, 2026, that it had completed the cancellation of 2,600,000 ordinary shares, corresponding to 3.47% of issued shares before cancellation as determined by the Board of Directors on October 8, 2026. The cancellation was executed under Article 178 of the Companies Act. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares (excluding treasury stock) stands at 72,412,540 shares.
